guides.title: New to action cards?
guides.sub: A plain guide to what action cards are and how to make and use them.

items.a: ELUM is a visual schedule app that shows daily routines as action cards (picture sequence cards). A caregiver describes the situation, and ELUM breaks it into easy steps on cards. Elumi then follows along one card at a time, looking at the pictures and listening to the voice.

Yes, it's free to start. You can make cards with Emoji pictures and Picture symbols for free. Cartoon pictures and Photo-like pictures, which AI draws for each card, and a few other features come with the Pro subscription.

We had in mind people with developmental disabilities or on the autism spectrum who find pictures and sequences easier than words, people with ADHD or learning disabilities who want to see the order of tasks at a glance, and the parents, caregivers and teachers who help them through the day step by step.

items.q: Are AI-made cards shown right away?
items.a: No. Cards made by AI appear on the Elumi screen only after a caregiver checks and saves them. You can edit the sentences, pictures and order.

items.q: Do I need to enter a diagnosis or type of disability?
items.a: No. ELUM does not ask for a diagnosis or type of disability. What you write when making cards is sent to AI, so please don't include personal details like names or phone numbers. Learn more in our Privacy Policy.
No. You can switch between the caregiver screen and the Elumi screen on one device. If Elumi has their own device, you can also connect it.

items.q: How do I delete my account and data?
items.a: Delete your account in the app's settings. The steps are in our account and data deletion guide.

rewards.title: The moment it is done, it gets noticed

items.title: Check a card, and praise comes right away
items.body: Finish brushing, check the card, and a big star appears while a voice says "Well done!" The praise lands right when it is earned.

items.title: Finish the day, get the promised reward
items.body: After the last card, the reward the caregiver set shows on screen. Something small you can give right away, like one jelly or ten minutes of play, is enough.

items.title: The caregiver decides what it is
items.body: Stars in the app are a celebration. The real reward is chosen and handed over by the caregiver who knows Elumi best.

rewards.ctaHint: Free to start. Write one line and the cards are made.

together.title: The app doesn't do it for you
together.sub: ELUM is a tool. Setting the routine, staying close and giving praise are still the caregiver's part. ELUM is here to make that part a little lighter.

items.title: You decide
items.body: You know best what is easy and what is hard. Edit the cards and the reward.

items.title: Same place, every day
items.body: A day or two is not enough to get used to it. Keep the same time and the same order.

items.title: Point to the card instead of talking
items.body: When Elumi stops, don't rush them. Look at the current card together. Praise right away when it's done.
